data.name: Ghaalib
data.gender_notes: Ghaalib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghalaba' which means to conquer or overcome. In Islamic history, Ghaalib refers to a person who has conquered their own self and overcome their inner struggles. The name Ghaalib carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaalib usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and victory over personal challenges.
data.etymology: Ghaalib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaalib total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: غالب
in_arabic.long_meaning: غالب هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، وهو مشتق من الفعل غلب، الذي يعني الانتصار والسيطرة، وقد ذکر في القرآن الكريم في سورة المائدة، ويحمل هذا الاسم معنى القوة والانتصار والزحف على الأعداء

in_urdu.name: غالب
in_urdu.long_meaning: غالب ایک اردو نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کامیاب اور زبردست، اور یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت مقبول ہے، کیونکہ یہ نام قوت اور فتح کا biểuندہ ہے

in_hindi.name: ग़ालिब
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़ालिब एक हिंदी नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है विजयी और मजबूत, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, क्योंकि यह नाम शक्ति और जीत का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: غالب
